text: くだりざか　いっきに　おりると　きもち　いいぜ！

structure.jp: くだりざか　いっきに　おりると
structure.en: when you go down the slope in one go

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever that happens', the next thing always follows. おりると = 'when you go down'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly emphasis. きもち　いいぜ = 'it feels great, man'.
